description: This file defines a React component called SourceChooser, which allows users to select a source file from a list. It includes functions for rendering source options, grouping them by category, and providing a default empty source object. The file also imports external React types and a custom Source type.

methods.name: renderSourceOptions
methods.description: Generates React nodes to represent options grouped by category for source files.

methods.name: emptySource
methods.description: Returns a default empty Source object.
